# Debloat

**[Download debloat-pritom-m10.zip](https://github.com/CyberspaceVii/debloat-pritom-m10/releases/download/v0.1/debloat-pritom-m10.zip)**


Pick which preinstalled apps to remove — one by one, during install.

A KernelSU Next module for the **Pritom Max 10 (M10_R01)**. Companion to the unlock/root guide:
[unlock-tools-pritom-m10](https://github.com/CyberspaceVii/unlock-tools-pritom-m10).

The installer walks a short survey. For each app it asks `Remove <app>?` and you answer with the
volume keys — **Volume Up = Yes, Volume Down = No** (no press within 10 seconds counts as No, so the
app stays). Each app you remove is hidden systemlessly (a whiteout in the module overlay); the stock
files on `/system` and `/product` are never touched.

## What it offers

Factory / test and telemetry:

- PCB Test (`com.flyz.pcbtest`) — assembly-line hardware test app
- Validation Tools (`com.sprd.validationtools`) — SPRD/Unisoc factory validation app
- GMS Sample Integration (`com.google.android.gmsintegration`)
- Location History (`com.google.android.gms.location.history`)
- Adaptive Battery / Turbo (`com.google.android.apps.turbo`)
- Digital Wellbeing (`com.google.android.apps.wellbeing`)

Google extras:

- YouTube, YouTube Music, Google TV / Videos, Play Books, Maps, Meet / Duo, Photos, Keep Notes

Kids:

- Kids Space (`com.google.android.apps.kids.home`)
- YouTube Kids (`com.google.android.apps.youtube.kids`)

Core system, GMS, Play Store, WebView, launcher, keyboard and setup are **not** offered.

## Requirements

- Pritom Max 10 (M10_R01)
- Rooted with KernelSU Next

The installer stops without changing anything if either is missing.

## Install

1. Download [`debloat-pritom-m10.zip`](https://github.com/CyberspaceVii/debloat-pritom-m10/releases/latest/download/debloat-pritom-m10.zip) (latest release).
2. KernelSU Next → Modules → Install from storage → select the zip.
3. Answer the survey with the volume keys, then reboot.

## Uninstall

Disable or remove the module and reboot; the removed apps come back. One caveat: a Google app that had
been updated through the Play Store has its update dropped on removal, so it reinstalls from the Play
Store rather than reappearing automatically.
